description: Defines the class google_breakpad::LinuxPtraceDumper for extracting crash info via ptrace on Linux, including methods for process memory copying, thread management, and path building.

classes.name: LinuxPtraceDumper
classes.description: A class derived from LinuxDumper to extract crash info from a process via ptrace, managing thread suspension and process memory reading.

methods.name: LinuxPtraceDumper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dumper with a process ID.

methods.name: BuildProcPath
methods.description: Builds a /proc/<pid>/<node> path for a given process and node.

methods.name: CopyFromProcess
methods.description: Copies memory content from a target process using ptrace.

methods.name: GetThreadInfoByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific thread by index.

methods.name: IsPostMortem
methods.description: Indicates this dumper is for live process crash dump (returns false).

methods.name: ThreadsSuspend
methods.description: Suspends all threads in the process.

methods.name: EnumerateThreads
methods.description: Enumerates all threads of the process.
